Qualified transaction declares READ COMMITTED before first destination snapshot and SET LOCAL ROLE without acquiring a user fence in client code; the RPC takes/releases every row lock within that one call. No interactive multi-statement owner transaction holds the fence.
writer_RPC_and_snapshot_rules_A3_A4.volatility: RPC and any lease-check SQL/PLpgSQL helper are VOLATILE, fixed search_path. Lock the existing user row and frontier, then issue separate fresh SQL statements for publication attempts and history plans state IN(admitted,prepared) AND lease_until>clock_timestamp(). STABLE snapshot-sharing helpers are forbidden. Missing frontier is valid only for exact absent insert; missing owner always refuses.
writer_RPC_and_snapshot_rules_A3_A4.atomicity: Validate enabled settings, approved verifier receipt/nonce, exact source READY image, current generation/readiness/admission/privacy/ownership and whole-user completion before CAS. Consume approval and append mutation audit atomically. Normal renewal/revoke refuses any live lease. On ambiguous commit read exact audited receipt, no blind resend.

Integers represented as decimal strings in [0,9223372036854775807]; reject -0,+,negative,leadingzero or unsafe numeric coercions. UTC timestamp rendering uses explicit UTC microseconds via to_char (no JSDate truncation), finite AD years0001..9999 only. Existing planner input restrictions remain stricter where applicable.
codec_and_independent_evidence_B2_A5_A6_.every_component: Every supplementary component commitment hashes canonical {protocol,scope,component,status,rowCount,terminalProofSha256,rowsSha256}. Assigned independent reviewer approval of that exact receipt is mandatory before each frontier write. Owner writes approval into separate append-only ledger; writer cannot self-approve, accept a preparer boolean, stale report or replayed nonce. Hashes are commitments, not fabricated cryptographic signatures.
